children: Orrstown Financial Services said it sold available-for-sale securities with a total amortized cost of $185.6 million in a strategic repositioning of its portfolio.

The holding company for Orrstown Bank said the securities it sold had a weighted average yield of 3.13%, while proceeds are being used to purchase higher-yielding securities with an estimated weighted average yield of 5.2%.

Orrstown Financial estimates the transactions will result in a net pre-tax loss of $13.8 million in the fourth quarter. It expects the repositioning will add to net income, net interest income, net interest margin and return on average assets in future periods.
